title: Environmental Kuznets Curve and green regulation
abstract: In this paper, we first test the validity of the Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) hypothesis using a large sample of approximately 190 advanced and developing countries over the period 1989–2022. We find that CO2 emissions respond positively to increases in income per capita up to a turning point of approximately US$25,000. In a departure from the previous literature, we allow the relationship between economic development and emissions to depend on the stringency of environmental regulation. To guide the empirical analysis, we also develop a simplified theoretical framework linking economic development, emissions, and climate policy, highlighting the channels through which regulation affects both the level and curvature of the income–emissions relationship. Our results indicate that environmental policies—and particularly market-based instruments such as carbon taxes—make the EKC lower and flatter. These findings are robust to several sensitivity checks, including an instrumental variable strategy and the use of regional (rather than global) data. Overall, the results have important policy implications, showing that environmental policies are an essential ingredient for achieving long-run decoupling between emissions and economic output.
abstract_zh: 本文首先利用1989至2022年间约190个发达国家和发展中国家的大样本，检验环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）假说的有效性。我们发现，当人均收入达到约25,000美元的转折点之前，二氧化碳排放随人均收入增加而上升。与以往文献不同，我们允许经济发展与排放之间的关系取决于环境监管的严格程度。为指导实证分析，我们还构建了一个简化的理论框架，将经济发展、排放和气候政策联系起来，揭示监管影响收入—排放关系水平和曲率的渠道。结果表明，环境政策，尤其是碳税等基于市场的工具，会使EKC整体下移并变得更加平缓。这些发现在多项稳健性检验中均成立，包括工具变量策略以及使用区域（而非全球）数据。总体而言，研究结果具有重要的政策含义：环境政策是实现排放与经济产出长期脱钩的必要条件。

title: How economic and policy uncertainty shapes the stringency of climate change policies
abstract: This paper examines the impact of uncertainty on the stringency of climate change policies using data for 37 advanced and emerging economies over the period 1990–2020. We find that higher uncertainty is significantly associated with greater stringency in market-based climate change policies, such as carbon taxes and emissions trading schemes, while non-market-based and technology-support policies show no statistically significant effects. These results suggest that uncertainty particularly influences policy areas that are politically costly and involve stronger distributive implications. The relationship remains robust across multiple sensitivity tests, including an instrumental variable approach, and is stronger in fully democratic countries and where governments are politically weak, but diminishes during economic downturns. We theoretically and empirically link our results to the literature analyzing the impact of uncertainty on the implementation of structural reforms, according to which periods of high uncertainty reduce the capacity of voters to attribute short-run economic costs to policy decisions. • This paper provides the first systematic empirical analysis of how economic and political uncertainty shapes the stringency of climate change policies across countries. • Using data for 37 advanced and emerging economies over 1990–2020, we show that uncertainty significantly increases the stringency of market-based climate policies, such as carbon taxes and emissions trading schemes. • Uncertainty has no statistically significant effect on non-market-based or technology-support climate policies, highlighting strong heterogeneity across policy instruments. • The effect of uncertainty is concentrated in fully democratic countries and in politically weak governments, consistent with uncertainty opening windows of opportunity for politically costly reforms. • The impact of uncertainty weakens during economic downturns, when recessions themselves already facilitate reform implementation. • Results are robust to extensive controls, alternative uncertainty measures, and an instrumental-variable strategy exploiting exogenous sources of uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1990至2020年间37个发达经济体和新兴经济体的数据，考察不确定性对气候变化政策严格程度的影响。我们发现，较高的不确定性与碳税和排放交易体系等基于市场的气候变化政策的严格程度显著正相关，而非市场型政策和技术支持型政策则未表现出统计上显著的影响。这些结果表明，不确定性尤其影响那些政治成本高、且具有较强收入分配效应的政策领域。在包括工具变量方法在内的多项敏感性检验中，该关系依然稳健；在完全民主国家以及政府政治地位较弱的国家，该关系更为明显，但在经济衰退期间则有所减弱。我们从理论和实证上将结果与分析不确定性对结构性改革实施影响的文献联系起来：根据该文献，高不确定性时期会降低选民将政策决策的短期经济成本归因于政策的能力。• 本文首次系统性地实证分析了经济和政治不确定性如何影响各国气候变化政策的严格程度。• 利用1990至2020年间37个发达经济体和新兴经济体的数据，我们发现不确定性显著提高了碳税和排放交易等基于市场的气候政策的严格程度。• 不确定性对非市场型或技术支持型气候政策没有统计上显著的影响，突显了不同政策工具之间的强烈异质性。• 不确定性的影响集中于完全民主国家和政治地位较弱的政府，这与不确定性为推行政治成本高昂的改革打开“机会之窗”的观点相一致。• 经济衰退期间不确定性的影响减弱，因为衰退本身已经有利于改革的推行。• 结果在纳入大量控制变量、替代不确定性指标以及利用外生不确定性来源的工具变量策略下依然稳健。

abstract: This paper investigates the effect of Climate Change Policies (CCPs) on green innovation, for a sample of 40 advanced and emerging market economies, and five economic sectors, during the period 2000–2021. Our results suggest that CCPs positively affect the production of green patents, with the effect intensifying gradually over time. The effect is larger for non-market-based and technology support policies—such as emission limits, feed-in tariffs and R&D subsidies—in countries with greater competitiveness and during periods of stronger economic activity—that is, higher GDP growth, lower uncertainty and financial stress. The results based on a difference-in-differences approach suggest that the positive effect of stricter CCPs on green innovation is stronger in sectors with limited financial constraints. • Climate Change Policies (CCPs) foster green innovation. • The effect is larger for non-market-based and technology-support climate policies, such as R&D subsidies. • The impact is amplified in periods of strong economic activity and in sectors with limited financial constraints.
abstract_zh: 本文以40个发达经济体和新兴市场经济体以及五个经济部门为样本，考察2000至2021年间气候变化政策（CCPs）对绿色创新的影响。结果表明，气候变化政策对绿色专利的产出有正向影响，且该影响随时间逐渐增强。对于非市场型和技术支持型政策（如排放限值、上网电价补贴和研发补贴），其影响更大，且在竞争力较强的国家以及经济活动较强劲的时期（即GDP增速较高、不确定性和金融压力较低时）更为显著。基于双重差分方法的结果表明，在金融约束较少的行业中，更严格的气候变化政策对绿色创新的正向效应更强。• 气候变化政策促进绿色创新。• 对于非市场型和技术支持型气候政策（如研发补贴），其影响更大。• 在经济活动强劲的时期以及金融约束较少的行业中，影响会被放大。

Firm-Level Climate Change Adaptation : Micro Evidence from 134 Nations
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Are firms adapting to climate change? This paper studies this question by combining geocoded World Bank Enterprise Survey data with spatially granular weather data to estimate temperature response functions for nearly 160,000 firms in 134 countries over a 15-year period. Our results show that market imperfections in low- and middle-income countries constrain firms’ ability to adapt. Small and medium-size firms in low- and low-middle income countries are most vulnerable, with revenues declining by 12 percent in years with temperatures 0.5◦C above historical averages. The impact is equally strong for manufacturing and services firms and result from declines in labor productivity and wages. Heat-sensitive sectors and less resilient firms are more severely affected, reinforcing the causal interpretation. Unique firm-level information on policy constraints including limited financing, burdensome regulations, and unsafe conditions suggest that such factors raise adaptation costs, undermining economic resilience to climate change.
abstract_zh: 企业是否正在适应气候变化？本文通过结合具有地理编码的世界银行企业调查数据与空间精细的气象数据，估计了134个国家近160,000家企业的温度响应函数，观测期为15年。结果表明，中低收入国家的市场不完善限制了企业的适应能力。低收入和中低收入国家的中小企业最为脆弱，在气温比历史平均水平高0.5°C的年份，其收入下降12%。制造业企业与服务业企业的受影响程度同样严重，影响来自劳动生产率和工资的下降。对热敏感的行业以及韧性较弱的企业受影响更为严重，这强化了因果解释。关于政策约束（包括融资受限、繁琐的监管和不安全的环境）的独特企业层面信息表明，这些因素提高了适应成本，削弱了经济应对气候变化的韧性。

title: The Economic Costs of Temperature Uncertainty
abstract: Beyond its environmental damage, climate change is predicted to produce significant economic costs. Combining novel high-frequency geospatial temperature data from satellites with measures of economic activity for the universe of US listed firms, this article examines a potentially important channel through which global warming can lead to economic costs: temperature uncertainty. The results show that temperature uncertainty—by increasing power outages, reducing labor productivity, and increasing the degree of exposure of firms to environmental and non-political risks, as well as economic uncertainty at the firm-level—persistently reduce firms’ investment and sales. This effect varies across firms, with those characterized by tighter financial constraints being disproportionally more affected.
abstract_zh: 除环境损害外，气候变化预计还将产生巨大的经济成本。本文结合卫星获取的高频地理空间温度数据与美国全部上市企业的经济活动指标，考察全球变暖可能导致经济成本的一个潜在重要渠道：温度不确定性。研究结果表明，温度不确定性通过增加停电、降低劳动生产率、提高企业面临的环境和非政治风险暴露，以及加剧企业层面的经济不确定性，持续地降低了企业投资和销售额。这一效应在不同企业间存在差异，融资约束较紧的企业受到的影响尤为严重。

Climate change policies and income inequality
abstract: This paper examines the dynamic impact of Climate Change Policies (CCPs) on income inequality, for a sample of 39 developed and developing countries, during the period 1990–2020. The results show that CCPs are associated with a significant and persistent increase in income inequality. The effect is robust across various measures of inequality and sensitivity tests, including an instrumental variable strategy. The effect of CCPs only materializes in the case of market-based CCPs, is stronger in countries characterized by a higher share of low-educated workers and initial level of inequality, while is mitigated in those with comprehensive redistribution policies, and during periods of fiscal expansions and stronger economic growth. These findings have important policy implications, as they emphasize the importance of the timing and design of CCPs, as well as the role of complementary policies.
abstract_zh: 本文以39个发达国家和发展中国家为样本，考察1990至2020年间气候变化政策（CCPs）对收入不平等的动态影响。结果表明，气候变化政策与收入不平等的显著且持续上升相关。该结论在多种不平等衡量指标和敏感性检验（包括工具变量策略）下均成立。该效应仅在基于市场的气候变化政策中显现；在低学历劳动者比重较高和初始不平等程度较高的国家，该效应更强；而在实施全面再分配政策的国家，该效应有所缓解；在财政扩张时期和经济增长较强劲的时期，该效应也有所减弱。这些发现具有重要的政策含义，强调了气候变化政策实施时机和设计的重要性，以及配套政策的作用。

Are climate change policies politically costly?
abstract: Are policies designed to avert climate change (Climate Change Policies, or CCPs) politically costly? Using data on governmental popular support and the OECD’s Environmental Stringency Index, we find that CCPs are not necessarily politically costly: policy design matters. First, only market-based CCPs (such as emission taxes) generate negative effects on popular support. Second, the effects are muted in countries where non-green (dirty) energy is a relatively small input into production. Third, political costs are not significant when CCPs are implemented during periods of low oil prices, generous social insurance and low inequality.
abstract_zh: 旨在避免气候变化的政策（气候变化政策，即CCPs）是否具有政治成本？利用政府民众支持率数据以及经合组织的环境严格度指数，我们发现气候变化政策未必具有政治成本：政策设计至关重要。第一，只有基于市场的气候变化政策（如排放税）才会对民众支持率产生负面影响。第二，在非绿色（高污染）能源在生产投入中占比相对较小的国家，这些效应较弱。第三，在石油价格较低、社会保险慷慨且不平等程度较低的时期实施气候变化政策时，政治成本并不显著。

abstract: Lockdowns resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic have reduced overall energy demand but electricity generation from renewable sources has been resilient. While this partly reflects the trend increase in renewables, the empirical analysis presented in this paper highlights that recessions result in a permanent, albeit small, increase in energy efficiency and in the share of renewables in total electricity. These effects are stronger in the case of advanced economies and when complemented with environment and energy policies—both market-based measures such as taxes on pollutants, trading schemes and feed-in-tariffs, as well as non-market measures such as emission and fuel standards and R&D investment and subsidies—to incentivize and hasten the transition towards renewable sources of energy.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情导致的封锁使总体能源需求下降，但可再生能源发电却表现出韧性。尽管这在一定程度上反映了可再生能源的长期增长趋势，但本文的实证分析表明，经济衰退会导致能源效率以及可再生能源在总电力中的占比出现永久性（尽管幅度较小）的提升。这些效应在发达经济体中更为显著，并且当辅以环境与能源政策时更加明显——既包括污染物税、交易体系和上网电价等基于市场的措施，也包括排放与燃料标准以及研发投入和补贴等非市场措施——从而激励并加快向可再生能源的转型。

title: Oil prices and inflation dynamics: Evidence from advanced and developing economies
venue: Journal of International Money and Finance
abstract: We study the impact of fluctuations in global oil prices on domestic inflation using an unbalanced panel of 72 advanced and developing economies over the period from 1970 to 2015. We find that a 10 percent increase in global oil inflation increases, on average, domestic inflation by about 0.4 percentage point on impact, with the effect vanishing after two years and being similar between advanced and developing economies. We also find that the effect is asymmetric, with positive oil price shocks having a larger effect than negative ones. The impact of oil price shocks, however, has declined over time due in large part to a better conduct of monetary policy. We further examine the transmission channels of oil price shocks on domestic inflation during the recent decades, by making use of a monthly dataset from 2000 to 2015. The results suggest that the share of transport in the CPI basket and energy subsidies are the most robust factors in explaining cross-country variations in the effects of oil price shocks during the this period.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1970至2015年间72个发达经济体和发展中经济体的非平衡面板数据，研究全球石油价格波动对国内通胀的影响。我们发现，全球石油通胀每上涨10%，国内通胀平均在当期上升约0.4个百分点，该效应两年后消失，且在发达经济体和发展中经济体之间相似。我们还发现该效应是非对称的，正向油价冲击的影响大于负向冲击。然而，石油价格冲击的影响随时间推移有所下降，这在很大程度上归功于货币政策执行的改善。我们进一步利用2000至2015年的月度数据，考察近几十年间石油价格冲击影响国内通胀的传导渠道。结果表明，交通在CPI篮子中的占比和能源补贴是解释这一时期各国石油价格冲击效应差异最为稳健的因素。
